name: Past Continuous
summary: Past Continuous o'tgan zamonda ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etib turgan harakatlarni bildiradi. Biz uni o'tgan zamondagi jarayonni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz.

usage.text: O'tgan zamonda aniq bir vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni bildirish uchun.

example.en: At 8 PM yesterday, I was watching TV.
example.uz: Kecha soat kechki 8 da men televizor ko'rayotgan edim.

usage.text: O'tgan zamonda ikkita harakat bir vaqtning o'zida davom etganini ko'rsatish uchun.

example.en: While I was cooking, my sister was cleaning the room.
example.uz: Men ovqat pishirayotgan paytimda, opam xonani tozalayotgan edi.

usage.text: O'tgan zamonda fon (tariqa) bo'lib xizmat qiluvchi harakatlar uchun.

example.en: The sun was shining when we woke up.
example.uz: Biz uyg'onganimizda quyosh porlab turgan edi.

structure.formula: Yes, subject + was/were. / No, subject + wasn't/weren't.

example.en: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

tip: Eslatma: 'I, he, she, it' olmoshlari bilan 'was', 'you, we, they' olmoshlari bilan esa 'were' ishlatilishini unutmang!

name: Past Simple vs Past Continuous (when / while)
name_uz: Past Simple va Past Continuous vaqtlarning solishtiruvi
summary: Biz bu qoidani o'tgan zamonda biror harakat davom etib turganda to'satdan boshqa bir qisqa harakat sodir bo'lganini aytish uchun ishlatamiz.

usage.text: Uzun davom etayotgan harakatni to'satdan sodir bo'lgan qisqa harakat to'xtatib qolganda.

example.en: I was walking in the park when it started to rain.
example.uz: Men bog'da sayr qilib yurgan edim, to'satdan yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

usage.text: 'While' bog'lovchisidan keyin odatda Past Continuous (davomiy harakat) keladi.

example.en: While she was studying, her phone rang.
example.uz: U dars qilib o'tirgan paytda telefoni jiringladi.

usage.text: 'When' bog'lovchisidan keyin odatda Past Simple (qisqa harakat) keladi.

example.en: They were having dinner when I arrived.
example.uz: Men borganimda ular kechki ovqatni tanovul qilishayotgan edi.

example.en: I was sleeping when you called me.
example.uz: Siz menga qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda men uxlayotgan edim.

example.en: While we were talking, the lights went out.
example.uz: Biz gaplashib turganimizda chiroq o'chib qoldi.

example.en: What were you doing when the accident happened?
example.uz: Avariya sodir bo'lganda sen nima qilayotgan eding?

tip: Eslatma: 'When' so'zidan keyin odatda Past Simple (qisqa zamon), 'while' so'zidan keyin esa Past Continuous (davomiy zamon) kelishini yodda saqlang!
